systems: KI-Modul Steuerveranlagung — Finanzverwaltung NRW (Pilotfinanzämter Brühl, Bielefeld-Außenstadt, Hamm, Lübbecke)
highlights: AlgorithmWatch report March 2025: predictive policing systems in Germany operate without adequate legal basis; risk of discrimination amplification.
NRW becomes first German state to deploy KI in tax assessment (May 2025 pilot, 4 offices); expands automation of legal-effect decisions.
CJEU (SCHUFA Holding case): credit scoring qualifies as automated decision-making under Art. 22 GDPR — citizens can challenge.
EU AI Act: prohibitions live since 2 Feb 2025; transparency duties (Art. 50) from 2 Aug 2026; Annex III high-risk rules (credit, employment, benefits, insurance) from 2 Dec 2027.
actions_taken: researched EU AI Act implementation status + German AI deployments + automated decision rights
